page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What the theory says
steps.why: The theory moves the origin of life elsewhere rather than explaining it, which is the usual criticism of it.
common_mistakes: Saying panspermia explains how life began. It says life came from elsewhere.
steps.memory_tip: Pan means everywhere, sperma means seed: seeds of life everywhere.
steps.margin_note: Say what panspermia ARE, not only what the theory claims.

steps.label: How life reached earth
steps.why: The spores had to survive the journey, which is why the theory insists they are resistant.
common_mistakes: Saying the spores were sent deliberately.
steps.memory_tip: They arrived by accident, not by design.

lines.text: The life might have reached earth accidentally

insider_note: Panspermia is the SPORES, not the theory. Name both — the resistant spores and the idea that they arrived from space.
